name: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery

cost.raw: 1 Willpower (per spell; each spell also has an Essence cost)

description: Lets the Dragon King learn and cast Terrestrial Circle spells. Dragon Kings cannot learn sorcery on their own — they must find an Exalt to teach them this ability — but once learned, they can learn the various spells without assistance. Sorcery spells cannot be included in any Combos. Costs 7 bonus points or 12 experience points to learn. (PG p.192)
